actions.create_link.description: Create a new shortened link in your Dub workspace.
actions.create_link.props.android.descri: Redirect Android device visitors to this URL instead.
actions.create_link.props.archived.descr: Archive this link immediately after creation.
actions.create_link.props.comments.descr: Internal notes about this link (not shown to visitors).
actions.create_link.props.description.de: A short description of what the link points to.
actions.create_link.props.doIndex.descri: Allow search engines to index this short link.
actions.create_link.props.domain.descrip: The domain to use for the short link (e.g. `dub.sh`). If omitted, the primary workspace domain is used.
actions.create_link.props.expiredUrl.des: URL to redirect to after the link expires.
actions.create_link.props.expiresAt.desc: ISO 8601 datetime when the link should expire (e.g. `2025-12-31T23:59:59Z`). Expired links redirect to the expiration URL.
actions.create_link.props.externalId.des: Your internal database ID for this link. Must be unique per workspace. Useful for looking up the link later.
actions.create_link.props.folderId.descr: The unique ID of an existing folder to assign this link to.
actions.create_link.props.image.descript: Custom link preview image (og:image). Used when Custom Link Previews (`proxy`) is enabled.
actions.create_link.props.ios.descriptio: Redirect iOS device visitors to this URL instead.
actions.create_link.props.key.descriptio: Custom slug for the short link (e.g. `my-promo`). If omitted, a random 7-character slug is generated.
actions.create_link.props.password.descr: Password-protect the link. Visitors must enter this password before being redirected.
actions.create_link.props.proxy.descript: Enable Custom Link Previews (og:title, og:description, og:image) for this link.
actions.create_link.props.rewrite.descri: Cloak the destination URL — visitors see the short link URL in the browser.
actions.create_link.props.tags.descripti: List of tag names to attach to this link.
actions.create_link.props.title.descript: A human-readable title for the link (used in the Dub dashboard).
actions.create_link.props.trackConversio: Whether to track conversions for this link.
actions.create_link.props.url.descriptio: The full destination URL the short link should redirect to.
actions.create_link.props.utm_content.de: UTM content parameter for A/B testing.
actions.create_link.props.utm_term.descr: UTM term parameter for paid search keywords.
actions.create_link.props.video.descript: Custom link preview video (og:video). Used when Custom Link Previews (`proxy`) is enabled.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_link.description: Permanently delete a Dub link. This action cannot be undone.
actions.delete_link.props.linkId.descrip: The ID of the link to delete (e.g. `clv3g2...`). Find this from the Create Link or List Links actions.
actions.get_link.description: Retrieve details of a specific Dub link by its ID, external ID, or domain + key.
actions.get_link.props.domain.descriptio: The domain of the link (e.g. `dub.sh`). Used when Look Up By = Domain + Key.
actions.get_link.props.externalId.descri: Your internal ID for the link. Pass with prefix `ext_` (e.g. `ext_123456`). Used when Look Up By = External ID.
actions.get_link.props.key.description: The slug of the link (e.g. `my-promo`). Used when Look Up By = Domain + Key.
actions.get_link.props.linkId.descriptio: The Dub-generated link ID (e.g. `clv3g2...`). Used when Look Up By = Link ID.
actions.get_link.props.lookupMethod.desc: How to identify the link you want to retrieve.
actions.list_links.description: Retrieve a paginated list of links in your Dub workspace.
actions.list_links.props.domain.descript: Filter by a specific domain (e.g. `dub.sh`). Leave empty to return all domains.
actions.list_links.props.pageSize.descri: Number of links to return per page (1–100). Default is 100.
actions.list_links.props.search.descript: Search links by their URL, title, or slug.
actions.list_links.props.showArchived.de: Whether to include archived links in the results.
actions.list_links.props.tagNames.descri: Filter by one or more tag names.
actions.list_links.props.userId.descript: Filter links created by a specific user ID.
actions.update_link.description: Update an existing Dub link. Only the fields you fill in will be updated.
actions.update_link.props.comments.descr: Update internal notes for this link.
actions.update_link.props.doIndex.descri: Allow search engines to index this short link.
actions.update_link.props.expiredUrl.des: URL to redirect to after expiration.
actions.update_link.props.expiresAt.desc: ISO 8601 datetime when the link should expire. Set to empty to remove expiration.
actions.update_link.props.folderId.descr: Move this link to a different folder by its ID.
actions.update_link.props.image.descript: Update the custom link preview image (og:image).
actions.update_link.props.key.descriptio: Update the short link slug (the part after the domain).
actions.update_link.props.linkId.descrip: The ID of the link to update (e.g. `clv3g2...`). Find this from the Create Link or List Links actions.
actions.update_link.props.password.descr: Update the password for this link. Leave blank to remove password protection.
actions.update_link.props.proxy.descript: Enable or disable Custom Link Previews (og:title, og:description, og:image) for this link.
actions.update_link.props.tags.descripti: Replace the link's tags with this new list of tag names. Send an empty array to clear all tags.
actions.update_link.props.trackConversio: Whether to track conversions for this link.
actions.update_link.props.url.descriptio: Update the destination URL the link redirects to.
actions.update_link.props.video.descript: Update the custom link preview video (og:video).
auth.description:
To obtain your Dub API key:
1. Go to [https://app.dub.co/settings/tokens](https://app.dub.co/settings/tokens)
2. Click **Create API Key**
3. Give your key a name and select the required scopes
4. Copy the key — it starts with `dub_` (e.g. `dub_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx`)
5. Paste it here

> **Required scopes:** `links.read`, `links.write`, `webhooks.write` (for triggers)
description: Dub is the modern link attribution platform for creating, managing, and analysing short links, tracking conversions, and running affiliate programmes.
triggers.link_clicked.description: Triggers in real time whenever one of your Dub short links is clicked.
triggers.link_clicked.props.md.descripti:
## Setup Instructions

1. Go to your Dub workspace and navigate to **Settings → [Webhooks](https://app.dub.co/settings/webhooks)**.
2. Click **Create Webhook**.
3. Give your webhook a name.
4. Paste the following URL into the **URL** field:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
5. Under **Events**, select **link.clicked**.
6. Click **Create webhook**.
triggers.link_created.description: Triggers in real time whenever a new short link is created in your Dub workspace.
triggers.link_created.props.md.descripti:
## Setup Instructions

1. Go to your Dub workspace and navigate to **Settings → [Webhooks](https://app.dub.co/settings/webhooks)**.
2. Click **Create Webhook**.
3. Give your webhook a name.
4. Paste the following URL into the **URL** field:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
5. Under **Events**, select **link.created**.
6. Click **Create webhook**.
